newsitem.title: USA: Motorola trades lower ahead of market open.
newsitem.headline: Motorola trades lower ahead of market open.

text.p: Shares of Motorola Inc tumbled in pre-opening trade after the company forecast a disappointing third quarter it said could fall below second quarter levels and analysts' Q3 estimates.

Instinet said Motorola traded as low as 46 and was trading at 46-1/2, off from Tuesday's close of 50-3/4. There was little activty in other semiconductors, but Intel Corp was trading at 84, off slightly from Tuesday's close of 84-5/16. "Obviously this is not good news, and it's going to put some pressure on Motorla and the market," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
Motorola reported Q2 earnings of $0.54 per share, and analysts expected it to earn $0.50 per share in the third quarter, according to First Call.

Motorola, in its statement early Wednesday, cited continued weakness in pricing and unit demand in semiconductor products. It also said the second quarter's pricing pressures in cellular, paging and modems continue, and sales and orders have also been weaker in international markets in the third quarter.

Shares of cellular phone rivals were also seen moving lower. Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson ADRS were not yet trading, but its shares moved lower in Stockholm trade. It slumped four crowns to 156.50 crowns following the report.
ADRS of Finnish telecom company Oy Nokia AB were trading at 40-1/8 on Instinet, off Tuesday's close of 41-1/4.
